def transform(grid):
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(r[c] == 3 for r in grid)]
    seps = [-1] + cols + [len(grid[0])]
    panels = {}
    for a, b in zip(seps, seps[1:]):

        nz = [v for r in blk for v in r if v != 0]

    for c in reversed(PRIORITY):  # lowest priority painted first

        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                if blk[i][j] != 0:
                    g[i][j] = c
    return g
'''
